answer.reason: Mishael, named Meshach, is known for being set over Babylon's affairs and for surviving the fiery furnace after refusing to worship the golden image.

clauses.english: was set over the affairs of the province of Babylon
clauses.quote: he set Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, over the affairs of the province of Babylon

clauses.english: was cast into the burning fiery furnace for refusing to worship the golden image, and came out unharmed
clauses.quote: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, came forth of the midst of the fire.

doubts: Mishael is named Meshach in the verses (DAN 1:7); the clauses rest on verses naming Meshach with Shadrach and Abednego.
The clause on the furnace joins being cast in and coming out as one event.
